tests.environment: macOS, isolated synthetic PostgreSQL 17 on 127.0.0.1:55492 (flowboard_harness; flowboard_access_test); no live data

security.reason: Origin/CSRF check (origin.ts) rejects null, lookalike and cross-site origins and Referer-only cross-site requests; legacy cookie covered (origin-check test; probe P5). Dev-login returns 404 with Worker bindings (session.ts:103). Admin secret is 32+ chars, timing-safe, no default outside NODE_ENV=test (admin-secret.ts). Google callback rejects unverified email and state mismatch with no session (google-auth-system test). Deductions: anonymous 401/404 existence oracle (R2-02); raw session IDs in sessions.id (R2-07, info); the Worker still accepts a localhost Origin by design (R2-08).

correctness.reason: Mounted board matrix behaves as specified in the probes: Owner and grant-holding Member write (201), Viewer with grant gets 403, revoked member gets 404 on replay and no body (P2/P4). Deduction: a comment POST on a card that is being moved fails with a retryable 503 in 10 of 10 forced interleavings (R2-01), which is a user-visible correctness failure under concurrency. Anonymous existence oracle (R2-02). Below the 8.5 minimum.

integrity.reason: Board-row FOR UPDATE fix (rbac.ts:397-398) removes the 6-way same-board create/move deadlock: 15 rounds with no 500 or 503 (P1). Grant revocation takes membership, grant and board locks in a fixed order (board-grants-foundation.ts; migration 0007 trigger). Deduction: the comment route takes the card row FOR SHARE before the board lock while move takes board then card FOR UPDATE, so the two deadlock (R2-01, 40P01 surfaced as 503). The lock-order rule is not enforced for card and comment rows. Below 8.5 minimum.

tests.reason: 381 API and 41 contract tests pass with 0 skipped on real PostgreSQL and workerd (reviewer-complete-suite.log). Concurrency tests drive mounted handlers through app.request, use pg_stat_activity to force interleavings, and check the 503 retry mapping. Deductions: no test for the comment-versus-move deadlock (R2-01); no mounted test that a board-scoped write replay after revocation is denied (R2-04); the deployed admin-secret rule is only tested at helper level (board-concurrency test:78-82); Google tests mock the provider. Below 8.5 minimum.

maintainability.reason: Shared helpers (rbac.ts, board-grants-foundation.ts) give one lock protocol and one grant predicate. Deductions: stale comments contradict mounted code (board-grants-foundation.ts:1-14 says routes do not use the module; migration 0007 header says do not deploy) (R2-05); duplicated grant predicates across adapters; draft modules named *-draft.ts remain in production source; lock order is a comment, not a check.

operations.reason: Request body limit, deadline, no-store headers, safe 500 mapping, 40P01/40001 mapped to 503 with Retry-After (error-handler.ts), per-request pool with end() in worker.ts. Deduction: no measured performance; retry mapping is verified by a synthetic handler test only. Scores meet the 7.0 minimum.

findings.description: Lock-order inversion between a comment POST and a move of the same card, reproducible. Comment route takes the card row FOR SHARE (apps/api/src/http/routes/comments.ts:92) before its receipt check takes the board row FOR UPDATE (comments.ts:111 -> apps/api/src/adapters/rbac.ts:397-398). Move takes the board FOR UPDATE first (routes/cards.ts:240 receipt check -> rbac.ts:397-398) then the card row FOR UPDATE (apps/api/src/adapters/cards.ts:714). Repro: reviewer-r2-comment-lock-probe.ts (forced interleaving): 10 of 10 comment requests returned 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; control move-versus-move returned 200/409 with no deadlock. Impact: a normal comment fails with a retryable error whenever that card is moved concurrently; no data corruption seen. Counterevidence: no 500 response; the 503 mapping is intentional (error-handler.ts:145-159). Move and trash are not affected (routes/trash.ts:61,193 take the board first). Fix: take the board lock before the card-row FOR SHARE on comment routes (or drop the card-row lock and rely on the board lock), then add a forced-interleaving regression test for comment versus move.
findings.rationale: Criterion 10 requires parallel writes on one board never to deadlock. A reproduced deadlock contradicts it even though the client sees a retryable 503 and not a 500.

findings.description: No mounted-handler test shows that a board-scoped write replay with the same Idempotency-Key after grant revocation is denied. Reviewer probe P2 shows the behaviour is correct (404, no saved body) via checkOrReplayProjectWriteReceipt (apps/api/src/adapters/idempotency.ts:53-64) and routes/cards.ts:67, but the suite does not assert it. The parallel-write test in board-concurrency.test.ts:16-62 also misses R2-01.
findings.rationale: Criterion 5 explicitly lists replay among the mounted matrix cases. Missing coverage is unproved, not a pass.

findings.description: Unauthenticated GET /api/v1/boards/:boardId returns 401 for an existing board and 404 for a missing one (apps/api/src/http/routes/boards.ts:140-151: existence check runs before authentication). Repro: reviewer-r2-probes.log P3 (401 vs 404). Impact: an anonymous caller who already has a board ID can learn that it exists. Counterevidence: board IDs are opaque, and authenticated non-grant users get the same 404 as a missing board. Fix: authenticate before the existence check, or return the same 404 for both.
findings.rationale: Criterion 4 names revoked and never-granted actors, not anonymous callers. Recorded as a non-enumeration hygiene gap.

findings.description: Card GET (apps/api/src/adapters/cards.ts:425-454, requireCardBoardAccess on the bare pool at :440-447) and image reads (apps/api/src/adapters/images.ts:540-548, requireImageBoardAccess on the bare pool) check the grant in autocommit statements and deliver afterwards, so a revocation committed during the read can still deliver that one response. Other reads (board snapshot, comments, trash, placement) hold the grant through delivery. Not probed. Counterevidence: the check runs before delivery, as criterion 1 requires.
findings.rationale: Consistency gap with the held-grant read pattern. Low because the window is a single in-flight response.

findings.description: Stale documentation contradicts mounted code: apps/api/src/adapters/board-grants-foundation.ts:1-14 says the module is unmounted and existing routes do not use it, but boards.ts, comments.ts and trash.ts call it; database/migrations/0007_board_grants.sql:1-9 says do not deploy until routes are converted.
findings.rationale: Maintainability and review risk: a future reader may treat mounted authorization as unfinished.

findings.description: Carried DR1-04. Google callback overwrites display_name on every login (apps/api/src/http/routes/google-auth.ts:188-195) and creates a personal workspace for every first login, including invitees (google-auth.ts:202-215).
findings.rationale: Not in the frozen criteria. Identity-quality issue outside board access.

findings.description: Carried DR1-05. Session IDs are stored and looked up as raw bearer values (apps/api/src/adapters/session.ts:127 INSERT id; :170 WHERE s.id = $1). A database read exposes live session tokens.
findings.rationale: Hardening item, not exploitable without database access. Outside the frozen criteria.

findings.description: Origin check and credentialed CORS trust any http://localhost:* or 127.0.0.1 origin in every runtime, including the deployed Worker (apps/api/src/http/middleware/origin.ts:7-11, 20-22; app.ts:54). Cookies are SameSite=Lax, so a cross-site localhost page does not send the session cookie.
findings.rationale: Explicitly allowed by criterion 8. Recorded for awareness.

findings.description: Round-1 deadlock on same-board create and move. Resolved: rbac.ts:397-398 now locks the board FOR UPDATE up front. Evidence: 15 rounds of 6 parallel creates and 6 parallel moves with no 500 or 503 (reviewer-r2-probes.log P1); board-concurrency test (parallel writes never deadlock into 500).
findings.rationale: Verified from source and probe. The same class remains for comment versus move (R2-01).

findings.description: Round-1 test-only admin secret reachable from a Worker bundled with NODE_ENV=test. Resolved for deployed runtimes: deployed is derived from bindings (system.ts:10,22; admin-secret.ts:12) and the Worker always binds HYPERDRIVE or DATABASE_URL (runtime/worker.ts:16). Residual: the helper-level test does not drive the deployed route.
findings.rationale: Verified from source; mounted deployed-path test is absent (see R2-04 test gap).

findings.description: Round-1 missing Origin/CSRF check. Resolved: origin.ts wired at app.ts:97; origin-check test and probe P5 show cross-site rejection with 403.
findings.rationale: Verified by source, test and probe.

findings.description: Round-1 embedded-migrations drift with no check. Resolved: board-concurrency.test.ts:84-91 compares EMBEDDED_MIGRATIONS byte for byte with database/migrations/*.sql; it passes in reviewer-complete-suite.log.

Round-1 target changed during review. Round 2 target: git HEAD e32f837 with a clean tree at start; code under apps/, packages/, database/, scripts/ and root package files identical to d8ae9a7 per the builder; manifest digest recorded in this record.
findings.rationale: Process item; the manifest freezes the bytes reviewed.

findings.description: Rejected candidate: Origin/CSRF bypass with null Origin, Referer-only, lookalike localhost origin, legacy cookie name, leading-space cookie, or two-origin header (reviewer-r2-probes.log P5).
findings.rationale: All session-carrying variants returned 403. The two 204 results carried no session cookie (flowboard_sess) or a same-origin Origin. The fetch layer strips leading whitespace from Cookie values.

findings.description: Rejected candidate: trash/move card-versus-board deadlock (trash locks card then board in one JOIN statement).
findings.rationale: The forced probe (reviewer-r2-lock-order-forced-probe.log) shows no 40P01 in 10 rounds: trash.ts:61,193 take the board lock through the receipt check before the card lock.

findings.description: Rejected candidate: workspace activity leaks board-scoped events to non-owner members.
findings.rationale: adapters/activity.ts:431-458 returns 403 for members and 404 for outsiders; only the workspace Owner reads it.

findings.description: Rejected candidate: a grant-revoked member can replay a saved board write response.
findings.rationale: Probe P2: replay returned 404 with no saved body (reviewer-r2-probes.log).

findings.description: Rejected candidate: email-only dev-login reachable on the deployed Worker.
findings.rationale: session.ts:103 returns 404 when HYPERDRIVE or DATABASE_URL is bound; worker.ts:16 always binds one; the dev-login path is not reached on a deployed Worker.

hardBlockers: R2-01: reproduced comment-versus-move deadlock on one board (10 of 10 forced rounds, 503). Contradicts criterion 10 'never deadlock'.
R2-04: no mounted-handler proof that board-scoped replay after revocation is denied (criterion 5 coverage incomplete).
coverageGaps: Real Google OAuth, hosted Hyperdrive and live data are out of scope; Google callback tests use a mocked provider.
Dependency advisory status unverified (no network access).
Same card-row-first inversion not probed at routes/comments.ts:190 and :301, routes/images.ts:43 and routes/imports.ts:222.
Revocation committing during card GET or image reads (R2-03) not probed.
Race evidence is sampled (15/20/10 rounds), not exhaustive; no fault injection or mutation run (would need an edit to the target).
Scores below category minimum are recorded as-is, following round-1 precedent; verdict is fail.
